title: Dukes of Duchesca - Napoli '97
name: dukesofduchesca-napoli97
summary: Top-down car chase across Napoli, summer 1997: eight party items, one Fiat 500, a boot full of rauti, scooters and police on your tail.
description: Drive a pimped-up white Fiat 500 across a Napoli drawn from memory of a city atlas: the Posillipo promontory, Mergellina and Via Caracciolo, Castel dell'Ovo, the tight grid of the centro storico, the Rettifilo, the station, Capodimonte and Capodichino, with its monuments standing where you expect them: Piazza del Plebiscito, Palazzo Reale, Maschio Angioino, Castel dell'Ovo, Castel Sant'Elmo, the Duomo, the Museo Nazionale, the Stadio San Paolo, the Stazione Centrale. Collect the eight things no party can do without, refuel before the tank runs dry, shake off the scooter gangs with the horn, leave a lit rauto behind for whoever follows (and drive clear before it goes off), and reach Villa Doria d'Angri at Posillipo before the night is over. Palette-indexed graphics with exact colours on the ESP32-C6, a sunset that turns into night as you play, and an original four-track SID-like soundtrack that speeds up when you are being chased, with stereo-panned effects.
controls: D-Pad: point where to go, the car turns and accelerates. A: horn (scares scooters). B: light a rauto (banger). START: pause.
content_notice: Freely inspired by a 1980s television car-chase series; not affiliated with its rights holders. Code, art and music are original.
